plan.summary: Implementação completa do sistema de Crédito Habitação com 29 APIs REST, 6 microserviços (mortgage-service porta 4001, mortgage-backoffice-service porta 4011, mock-crc-service porta 4051, mock-cmd-service porta 4052, internal-assessment-service porta 4053, core-banking-service porta 4054), 3 tabelas novas (audit_log, gestor_assignments, manual_overrides), aprovações hierárquicas L1/L2/L3, biblioteca TAEG standard, logging de auditoria, eventos Socket.IO. Stack: SQLite via sql.js no Core, Express, proxy middleware com fixRequestBody, queryAll/queryOne/run síncronos.

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_simulations
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, property_value REAL, down_payment REAL, loan_amount REAL, term INTEGER, interest_rate REAL, monthly_payment REAL, total_amount REAL, taeg REAL, amortization_table TEXT, created_at DATETIME

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_applications
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, simulation_id TEXT, client_id TEXT, applicant_data TEXT, property_data TEXT, loan_amount REAL, term INTEGER, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('draft','submitted','pending_l1','pending_l2','pending_l3','pending_crc','pending_cmd','pending_internal','approved','rejected','cancelled')), created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients(id), FOREIGN KEY(simulation_id) REFERENCES mortgage_simulations(id)

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_documents
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, type TEXT, filename TEXT, url TEXT, uploaded_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_approvals
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, level TEXT CHECK(level IN ('L1','L2','L3','CRC','CMD','internal')), status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')), approver_id TEXT, approved_at DATETIME, comments TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_clauses
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, clause_text TEXT, type TEXT, added_by TEXT, added_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_scoring
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, score REAL, risk_level TEXT, details TEXT, calculated_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_contracts
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, contract_number TEXT UNIQUE, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('generated','sent','signed','active')), generated_at DATETIME, signed_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

tables_to_add.name: mortgage_disbursements
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, contract_id TEXT, amount REAL, recipient TEXT, disbursed_at DATETIME, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('pending','completed','failed')), FOREIGN KEY(contract_id) REFERENCES mortgage_contracts(id)

tables_to_add.name: audit_log
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entity_type TEXT, entity_id TEXT, action TEXT, user_id TEXT, timestamp DATETIME, details TEXT, ip_address TEXT

tables_to_add.name: gestor_assignments
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, gestor_id TEXT, assigned_at DATETIME, status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('active','completed')), FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

tables_to_add.name: manual_overrides
tables_to_add.columns: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, application_id TEXT, field TEXT, old_value TEXT, new_value TEXT, reason TEXT, performed_by TEXT, performed_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES mortgage_applications(id)

files_to_create.purpose: Biblioteca standard para cálculo de TAEG (Taxa Anual Efetiva Global) com fórmula regulamentar portuguesa. Exporta calculateTAEG(loanAmount, term, interestRate, fees): number.
Router para simulações de crédito habitação: POST / (criar simulação com TAEG), GET /:id (obter simulação existente). Usa calculateTAEG() do módulo taeg.ts. Retorna amortizationTable como array JSON.

Router para pedidos de crédito habitação: POST / (criar aplicação), GET / (listar), GET /:id (obter detalhes), PUT /:id (actualizar), POST /:id/submit (submeter para aprovação L1). Valida status transitions. Emite eventos 'mortgage.application.created', 'mortgage.application.submitted'.
Router para documentos: POST / (upload documento via base64), GET / com query ?applicationId, DELETE /:id. Armazena url como data:mime;base64,... Emite evento 'mortgage.document.uploaded'.

Router para aprovações: POST / (criar aprovação pendente), PUT /:id/approve (aprovar), PUT /:id/reject (rejeitar). Actualiza status da application. Emite eventos 'mortgage.approval.completed'. Valida níveis hierárquicos (L1 antes de L2 antes de L3).
Router para cláusulas: POST / (adicionar cláusula), GET / com query ?applicationId, DELETE /:id. Emite evento 'mortgage.clause.added'.
Router para scoring: POST / (calcular score), GET /:applicationId (obter score). Lógica mock: score baseado em loanAmount/applicantData. Emite evento 'mortgage.scoring.calculated'.

Router para contratos: POST / (gerar contrato), GET /:id, PUT /:id/sign (assinar contrato), PUT /:id/activate (activar). Emite eventos 'mortgage.contract.generated', 'mortgage.contract.signed', 'mortgage.contract.activated'.
Router para desembolsos: POST / (criar desembolso), PUT /:id/complete (marcar como completed). Emite evento 'mortgage.disbursement.completed'.

Router para operações backoffice (porta 4001, mas rota separada): POST /applications/:id/assign-gestor, POST /applications/:id/override, GET /audit-log com filtros. Usa tabelas gestor_assignments, manual_overrides, audit_log. Emite eventos 'mortgage.gestor.assigned', 'mortgage.override.applied'.
Módulo de audit logging. Exporta logAudit(entityType, entityId, action, userId, details, ipAddress). INSERT na tabela audit_log. Usado em todas as operações críticas (aprovações, overrides, etc).

Serviço mock CRC (Comissão de Riscos de Crédito). Porta 4051. Router Express com POST /api/crc/validate (retorna approved/rejected após 2s delay). Regra: aprovado se loanAmount < 300000 e riskLevel !== 'high'.
Serviço mock CMD (Conselho Macro-Directivo). Porta 4052. Router Express com POST /api/cmd/validate (retorna approved/rejected após 3s delay). Regra: aprovado se loanAmount < 500000.

Serviço de avaliação interna. Porta 4053. Router Express com POST /api/assessment/evaluate (retorna assessmentValue, condition após 1.5s delay). Lógica: assessmentValue = propertyValue * random(0.95, 1.05), condition = 'good'/'fair'/'poor'.
Serviço Core Banking real. Porta 4054. Router Express com GET /api/accounts/:id/balance, POST /api/accounts/:id/debit. Proxy direto para http://localhost:4001/api/accounts. Usa fixRequestBody.

Router na porta 4011 (novo servidor Express dedicado a backoffice). Proxy para http://localhost:4001/api/mortgage-backoffice. Middleware de auth separado para gestores (role: 'backoffice'). Usa fixRequestBody.
Entry point do servidor backoffice (porta 4011). Express app com cors, json, authMiddleware (valida role 'backoffice'), mortgageBackofficeProxy router, health check /health. Logging de acesso.
Entry point que lança os 4 serviços mock em portas separadas: mockCrc (4051), mockCmd (4052), internalAssessment (4053), coreBanking (4054). Um único processo com 4 Express apps.

files_to_modify.changes: Adicionar CREATE TABLE para as 11 novas tabelas (mortgage_simulations, mortgage_applications, mortgage_documents, mortgage_approvals, mortgage_clauses, mortgage_scoring, mortgage_contracts, mortgage_disbursements, audit_log, gestor_assignments, manual_overrides). Sem alterar tabelas existentes (clients, accounts, movements, balances, digital_access). Manter queryAll/queryOne/run síncronos conforme código atual.

Importar e registar os novos routers: mortgageSimulations em /api/mortgage/simulations, mortgageApplications em /api/mortgage/applications, mortgageDocuments em /api/mortgage/documents, mortgageApprovals em /api/mortgage/approvals, mortgageClauses em /api/mortgage/clauses, mortgageScoring em /api/mortgage/scoring, mortgageContracts em /api/mortgage/contracts, mortgageDisbursements em /api/mortgage/disbursements, mortgageBackoffice em /api/mortgage-backoffice. Sem alterar rotas existentes.

Adicionar seed data para mortgage_simulations (2 simulações exemplo), mortgage_applications (1 aplicação em status 'draft'), audit_log (1 entrada exemplo). Usar INSERT com lista explícita de colunas. Manter seed existente de clients/accounts/movements.

Adicionar proxy routes para os novos endpoints de mortgage: router.use('/mortgage', createProxyMiddleware(coreProxy('mortgage'))). Manter função fixRequestBody conforme código actual. Sem alterar proxies existentes (accounts, movements, transfers, clients, term-deposits).
Adicionar suporte para role 'backoffice' no payload JWT. Exportar função hasRole(req: AuthRequest, role: string): boolean para validação de permissões. Sem alterar lógica de autenticação existente.

Adicionar validação para permitir acesso ao /api/v1/mortgage sem role específica (acesso geral autenticado). Criar nova função hasRole() exportada para validações específicas de backoffice.
